summary: Russia launched a massive combined attack on Kyiv lasting over 18 hours involving ballistic missiles and Shahed drones, killing at least 15 people and damaging a business center in Holosiivskyi district. Ukraine retaliated with drone strikes on Russian oil refineries in Tatarstan and Krasnodar Krai, the Primorsko-Akhtarsk airfield, and energy infrastructure in Tambov and Moscow regions, causing a blackout in Crimea. Russian glide bombs struck Sumy and Donetsk regions while Ukrainian special forces suffered losses near Mala Volchya attempting to evacuate surrounded personnel.

points: Ukrainian air defense monitored and engaged multiple Shahed drone groups across Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Odesa, Sumy, and Poltava regions throughout the night, with monitoring channels reporting reactive Shaheds over Vyshhorod, Troieshchyna, and Holosiivskyi/Teremky districts of Kyiv (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70844, @mon1tor_ua/70848, @mon1tor_ua/70838, @mon1tor_ua/70846, @eRadarrua/106453, @kpszsu/73658, @kpszsu/73659, @kpszsu/73671, @kpszsu/73674, @kpszsu/73672, @kpszsu/73684, @eRadarrua/106474, @eRadarrua/106486, @eRadarrua/106484).

Ukrainian drones conducted retaliatory strikes on Russian energy infrastructure including oil refineries in Tatarstan and Krasnodar Krai, the Primorsko-Akhtarsk military airfield used for Shahed launches, a substation in Krasnodar Krai, and energy facilities in Tambov and Moscow regions, resulting in a reported blackout in Crimea (Source: @UkraineNow/83563).
Ukrainian special forces attempted to evacuate surrounded personnel near Mala Volchya but suffered losses according to Russian security sources cited by TASS (Source: @tass_agency/391316).
A KLO oil depot in Brovary district, Kyiv region, was damaged by Russian overnight attack with images showing significant fire damage (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32616).

Supermarket 'Fora' warehouses in Martusivtsi, Kyiv region, were attacked overnight; the facility had only been put into use last week after a previous attack on logistics infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/83570).

Ukrainian MP Kozyr warned of a difficult winter for residents of high-rise buildings in cities like Kyiv due to destroyed thermal power plants that cannot be quickly restored (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32612).
The launch of a Ukrainian solid fuel plant for Flamingo rockets in Denmark has been postponed until end of 2027 with project costs nearly tripling to over €150 million (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32618).

Russia launched a massive combined attack on Kyiv lasting over 18 hours involving ballistic missiles from Kursk direction and multiple waves of Shahed drones, with air alerts active across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv regions (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70850, @eRadarrua/106416, @eRadarrua/106441, @eRadarrua/106447, @mon1tor_ua/70851).

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's sustained 18-hour combined attack on Kyiv demonstrates continued capacity for large-scale missile-drone operations despite Ukrainian air defenses. The simultaneous Ukrainian strikes on multiple Russian energy facilities indicate growing long-range strike capabilities targeting strategic logistics. Russian glide bomb usage in Sumy and Donetsk suggests continued tactical air superiority in frontline areas. The ballistic missile threat from Kursk remains elevated, requiring sustained air defense readiness. Ukrainian special forces losses near Mala Volchya reveal risks in forward operations. The Belarus border narrative continues to justify northern force concentrations despite no detected sabotage activity.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian monitoring networks maintained continuous tracking of Shahed groups across seven regions, demonstrating robust early warning integration. Civilian air alerts functioned repeatedly in Kyiv, Zhytomyr, and Chernihiv regions. Ukrainian retaliatory strikes show coordinated targeting of Russian energy infrastructure supporting Shahed operations. The Danish Flamingo rocket plant delay indicates Western production timeline challenges. TCC confrontations in Vinnytsia and Dnipropetrovsk reflect domestic mobilization tensions. Hungarian closure of 'gold convoy' case suggests limited appetite for investigating Ukrainian financial flows.
sections.intelligence_notes: The discrepancy between Belarusian border offers and Ukrainian threat perception highlights information warfare dynamics. Russian use of Primorsko-Akhtarsk airfield for Shahed launches confirms its role as a key drone hub. Underground tunnel destruction in Orikhiv suggests Russian targeting of Ukrainian logistical adaptations. POW escape in Kharkiv reveals detention security vulnerabilities. Supermarket warehouse re-targeting indicates Russian focus on civilian supply chains. MP Kozyr's winter warning signals government preparation for energy crisis. Monitoring channel's 18-hour continuous coverage demonstrates open-source intelligence value.
